name: touchque-mcp-server
description: Touchque for AI assistants and agents: accurate SDK docs and an integration validator, and, with an agent identity, phone approvals before an agent acts.
long_description: Gives AI coding assistants the current Touchque SDK docs, types and an integration validator (no account, no network needed). With an AI agent's own Touchque identity (TQ_AGENT_ID and its private key), the agent can ask a person to approve an action on their Touchque phone, read the answer and hand the single-use approval token to the service that executes. The agent never approves anything itself.

tools.name: touchque_help
tools.description: Start here: what this server does and which tool to call next.

tools.name: get_touchque_docs
tools.description: The official Touchque SDK README for Node, Python, PHP, Go, .NET, Ruby or Java.

tools.name: get_sdk_types
tools.description: The Touchque SDK's type and class reference.

tools.name: ping_touchque_api
tools.description: Checks that a Touchque backend answers.

tools.name: validate_integration
tools.description: Checks a snippet against the current step-up model and security practice.

tools.name: touchque_agent_whoami
tools.description: Who this AI agent is in Touchque and what it may ask for (agent identity needed).

tools.name: touchque_request_approval
tools.description: Asks a person to approve an action on their Touchque phone (agent identity needed).

tools.name: touchque_get_approval
tools.description: The person's answer, with the single-use approval token once approved (agent identity needed).

tools.name: touchque_request_mandate
tools.description: Asks a person to approve a series of requests at once (agent identity needed).

tools.name: touchque_get_mandate
tools.description: A mandate's state and what is left (agent identity needed).

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: The agent's agt_… id from Touchque (Developers → AI agents). Leave empty for the docs tools only.

agent_key.title: Agent private key
agent_key.description: The agent's private key (JWK or PEM, or the path of a file holding it). Never a tq_ API key.

api_url.title: Touchque API
api_url.description: Only for a self-hosted or local Touchque.
